title: 第17章 独吞野猪第18章 新的功能
content_zh:
;;
陈平决定了，他要独吞这头野猪。
他有工具铲子，有玉佩空间，完全可以做到！
他先用铁锹试探着捅了捅野猪，确认它彻底死透。
然后，深吸一口气，忍着左臂持续的钝痛，开始尝试分解这庞然大物。
这远比他想象的更艰难。
从空间中取出镰刀。
镰刀虽锋利，毕竟不是割肉的……
他只能寻找关节的连接处，用镰刀反复切割那坚韧的筋腱和皮肉。
汗水混着血水和污物流进他的眼睛，刺痛。
他顾不上擦，只是机械地重复着动作：找到缝隙，切割连接。
每一次用力，左臂都传来尖锐的抗议。
他咬着牙，喉咙里发出低沉的、压抑的嘶吼。
不知过了多久，终于，一条粗壮的后腿被他从关节处分离下来。
他累得几乎要瘫倒，但看着那巨大的肉块，心里只有完成了一小步的紧迫。
他拖着那条沉重的猪腿，心念沟通玉佩。
嗡。
猪腿消失在原地，出现在空间的角落里，堆在白米旁边。
没有血迹渗出，空间的地面依旧黝黑。
他退出空间，再次面对血腥的屠宰场。

切割、分离、运送……循环往复。
每一次切割都耗尽他刚刚恢复的力气，每一次进入空间吞下几口生米，都只是为了支撑下一次更艰难的切割。
野猪的头颅最难处理，那坚硬的颅骨和粗壮的脖颈让他耗尽了最后一丝力气，几乎是凭着本能的狠劲，才最终将它分离。
当天边的太阳落下大半，整个野猪庞大的身躯已经消失不见……
只剩下猪圈中央一大片被血和污物浸透的泥泞，以及空气中浓得化不开的腥臭。
陈平瘫坐在角落，浑身像是散了架，左臂的疼痛因为持续的用力反而有些麻木了。
他强撑着最后一点清醒，用铁锹翻动四周的干粪和泥土，尽力掩盖住那片深色的血污。
又把猪圈破口处倒塌的碎石和痕迹弄得更加杂乱，像是野猪狂暴闯入又冲撞离开的样子。
做完这一切，他拖着疲惫不堪、浑身恶臭的身体，一步一挪地回到了自己那个低矮的窝棚。
回到窝棚，他甚至没力气去打水清洗，只是胡乱地扯掉最外面一层沾满污物的破布，蜷缩在冰冷的草铺上，昏死过去。
……
“陈平！死哪去了？！猪圈的活干完了吗！”
尖利刻薄的吼声像鞭子一样抽进窝棚。
陈平猛地惊醒，心脏狂跳，左臂的剧痛瞬间清晰。
天已大亮。
他挣扎着坐起，看到窝棚门口叉腰站着的，正是王管事那张油光光的胖脸，旁边跟着那个昨天逃跑的疤脸监工。
“王…王管事。”
陈平声音嘶哑，想站起来，身体却沉重得不像自己的。
“哼！看你这副死狗样！活肯定没干完！”
王管事嫌恶地用手在鼻子前扇了扇。

“废物！昨天就让你清理猪圈，磨蹭到现在？还弄得一身屎尿，晦气！今天别想吃饭了！”
陈平心头一沉，知道躲不过，只能硬着头皮开口，声音尽量平稳。
“王管事…活…活是没干完。昨天…昨天有头大野猪冲进猪圈，差点要了我的命…我好不容易才逃出来…”
他指了指自己缠着破布、明显不自然的左臂。
content_en:
;;
Chen Ping decided that he wanted to devour this wild boar for himself.
He has the tools, shovel, and space for the jade pendant, so he can definitely do it!
He first tentatively poked the wild boar with a shovel to confirm that it was completely dead.
Then, he took a deep breath, endured the constant dull pain in his left arm, and began to try to break down this behemoth.
It was far more difficult than he imagined.
Remove the scythe from space.
Although the sickle is sharp, it is not for cutting flesh...
He could only look for the joints of the joints and repeatedly cut the tough tendons and flesh with the sickle.
Sweat mixed with blood and dirt flowed into his eyes, stinging.
He didn't care about wiping, and just repeated the action mechanically: finding gaps, cutting and connecting.
Every time he exerted force, a sharp protest came from his left arm.
He gritted his teeth and let out a low, suppressed roar from his throat.
After an unknown amount of time, he finally separated a thick hind leg from its joint.
He was so tired that he almost collapsed, but looking at the huge piece of meat, he only felt the urgency to complete a small step.
He dragged the heavy pig leg and thought about the jade pendant.
Buzz.
The pork legs disappeared and appeared in the corner of the space, piled next to the white rice.
There was no blood seeping out, and the ground of the space was still dark.
He exited the space and faced the bloody slaughterhouse again.
Cutting, separating, transporting... the cycle repeats.
Every cut used up his newly recovered strength, and every time he entered the space and swallowed a few mouthfuls of uncooked rice, it was just to support the next more difficult cut.
The wild boar's head was the most difficult to deal with. The hard skull and thick neck made him use up his last bit of strength, and he finally separated it almost with instinctive force.
When the sun has set more than half of the sky, the entire huge body of the wild boar has disappeared...
All that was left was a large piece of mud soaked in blood and filth in the middle of the pigsty, and a fishy stench in the air that was so thick that it couldn't be resolved.
Chen Ping sat slumped in the corner, his whole body seemed to be falling apart, and the pain in his left arm became numb due to the continued exertion.
He held on to the last bit of consciousness and used a shovel to turn over the dry dung and soil around him, trying his best to cover up the dark blood.
The collapsed gravel and traces at the breach in the pig pen were further confused, as if a wild boar had entered and left wildly.
After doing all this, he dragged his exhausted and stinking body back to his low shack step by step.
When he returned to the shack, he didn't even have the energy to fetch water for cleaning. He just randomly tore off the outermost layer of rags stained with dirt, huddled on the cold grass bed, and passed out.
…
"Chen Ping! Where did he go?! Are you done with the pig pen?"
A sharp, vitriolic roar whipped into the shack like a whip.
Chen Ping woke up suddenly, his heart beating wildly, and the severe pain in his left arm was instantly clear.
It's daybreak.
He struggled to sit up and saw the fat, shiny face of Manager Wang standing with his arms akimbo at the door of the shack, followed by the scar-faced supervisor who had escaped yesterday.
"The king...the king is in charge."
Chen Ping's voice was hoarse and he wanted to stand up, but his body was not as heavy as his own.
"Hmph! Look at you, you look like a dead bitch! You must not be done yet!"
Manager Wang slapped his nose with his hand in disgust.
"Trash! I asked you to clean the pigsty yesterday, and you're still dragging your feet until now? You're still covered in feces and urine, bad luck! Don't even think about eating today!"
Chen Ping's heart sank. He knew he couldn't escape, so he could only bite the bullet and speak, keeping his voice as steady as possible.
"Manager Wang's...work...work is not finished. Yesterday...yesterday a big wild boar rushed into the pig pen and almost killed me...I managed to escape..."
He pointed at his left arm, which was wrapped in rags and looked unnatural.
